gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.988988 40.755324)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] < 440 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

),
terrain_below_440 AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Reclass(
    ST_Slope(ST_Union(rast)), 
    1, '0-1000:1', '8BUI', 1
  ))).geom AS geom
  FROM dem_clipped
  WHERE ST_Value(rast, 1) < 440
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom, t.geom)) AS distance_meters
FROM poi_geom p, terrain_below_440 t;
